# <span class="en">Data preparation and quality assessment</span><span class="zh">数据准备与质量评估</span> {#sec-prep}

::: {.en}
The preparation is carried out by two scripts, `scripts/01_boundaries.R` and
`scripts/02_acled.R`, reproduced in full in @sec-repro. This section walks
through the steps that change the data and the reason for each. The code
shown here is excerpted from those scripts and is not re-executed by the
report; the tables and figures are computed from the objects the scripts save.
:::

::: {.zh}
数据准备由两个脚本完成:`scripts/01_boundaries.R` 与 `scripts/02_acled.R`,
全文见 @sec-repro。本节逐一说明改变数据的步骤及其理由。这里展示的代码摘自上述
脚本,报告本身不会重新执行;表格与图形则由脚本保存的对象计算得出。
:::

## <span class="en">The township layer</span><span class="zh">镇区图层</span> {#sec-prep-bnd}

### <span class="en">Import and integrity checks</span><span class="zh">导入与完整性检查</span>

```{r}
#| label: prep-bnd-code
#| eval: false
ts <- st_read("data/raw/mimu_adm3/mmr_polbnda_adm3_250k_mimu_1.shp", quiet = TRUE)

geom_report <- list(
  n         = nrow(ts),
  invalid   = sum(!st_is_valid(ts)),
  empty     = sum(st_is_empty(ts)),
  dup_pcode = sum(duplicated(ts$TS_PCODE)),
  na_pcode  = sum(is.na(ts$TS_PCODE) | ts$TS_PCODE == ""),
  multipart = sum(vapply(st_geometry(ts), function(g) length(g) > 1L, logical(1)))
)
```

::: {.en}
Every local statistic in this report is indexed by polygon, so a duplicated
or missing identifier would silently corrupt every join that follows. The
layer is clean: `r bnd$geom_report$n` townships, `r bnd$geom_report$invalid`
invalid and `r bnd$geom_report$empty` empty geometries,
`r bnd$geom_report$dup_pcode` duplicated and `r bnd$geom_report$na_pcode`
missing `TS_PCODE`. `r bnd$geom_report$multipart` townships are multipart,
which is expected on an archipelagic coast and in Myanmar's river deltas, and
needs no correction.
:::

::: {.zh}
本报告中每个局部统计量都以多边形为索引,因此一个重复或缺失的标识符会悄无声息地
破坏之后的每一次连接。该图层是干净的:`r bnd$geom_report$n` 个镇区,
`r bnd$geom_report$invalid` 个无效几何、`r bnd$geom_report$empty` 个空几何,
`TS_PCODE` 重复 `r bnd$geom_report$dup_pcode` 个、缺失 `r bnd$geom_report$na_pcode`
个。有 `r bnd$geom_report$multipart` 个镇区是多部件多边形,这在多岛屿的海岸与缅甸的
河口三角洲属于正常现象,无需修正。
:::

### <span class="en">Choosing the projection by measuring it</span><span class="zh">通过测量来选择投影</span> {#sec-prep-crs}

::: {.en}
Myanmar spans `r sprintf("%.1f", 92.17)`° to `r sprintf("%.1f", 101.17)`° E,
across UTM zones 46N and 47N, so neither zone covers the country without
stretching it. Four candidate projections are scored on how far each
township's planar area departs from its ellipsoidal (geodesic) area, which is
the quantity that event densities in @sec-lmsa-sens depend on. The reference
is computed with s2 switched off, so that sf hands the calculation to
lwgeom's ellipsoidal geodesic routines rather than to s2's sphere.
:::

::: {.zh}
缅甸横跨东经 `r sprintf("%.1f", 92.17)`° 至 `r sprintf("%.1f", 101.17)`°,跨越
UTM 46N 与 47N 两个分带,任何一个分带都无法在不拉伸的情况下覆盖全国。本研究按每个
镇区的平面面积与其椭球(测地)面积之间的偏离程度,为四个候选投影打分,因为
@sec-lmsa-sens 中的事件密度取决于这一量。参照值在关闭 s2 的情况下计算,使 sf 把计算
交给 lwgeom 的椭球测地算法,而不是 s2 的球面。
:::

```{r}
#| label: tbl-crs
#| tbl-cap: "<span class='en'>Area distortion of four candidate projections against geodesic area, over all 330 townships. Ranked by the worst single township.</span><span class='zh'>四个候选投影相对测地面积的面积变形(覆盖全部 330 个镇区),按最差的单个镇区排序。</span>"

bnd$crs_scores |>
  mutate(crs = recode(crs,
    AEA_MMR  = "Albers equal-area, centred on Myanmar (12° N, 26° N)",
    LAEA_MMR = "Lambert azimuthal equal-area, centred on Myanmar",
    `EPSG:32647` = "WGS 84 / UTM 47N (EPSG:32647)",
    `EPSG:32646` = "WGS 84 / UTM 46N (EPSG:32646)")) |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(crs = "Projection", total_err_pct = "National total error (%)",
             max_abs_err_pct = "Worst township (%)",
             med_abs_err_pct = "Median township (%)") |>
  fmt_scientific(columns = c(total_err_pct, max_abs_err_pct, med_abs_err_pct),
                 decimals = 2) |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(13))
```

::: {.en}
Both equal-area projections keep every township's area to within a few
millionths of a per cent, which is expected, since preserving area is what
they are built to do. The UTM zones distort the worst township by more than
1%. The Albers projection is selected; its standard parallels at 12° N and
26° N sit inside the country's own latitude range. Distances, which matter for
the k-nearest-neighbour weights used in sensitivity analysis, are only mildly
affected at this scale.
:::

::: {.zh}
两个等积投影都把每个镇区的面积误差控制在百万分之几个百分点以内,这在意料之中,
因为保持面积正是它们的设计目的。UTM 分带对最差镇区的变形超过 1%。本研究选用
**Albers 等积投影**,其标准纬线 12° N 与 26° N 位于缅甸自身的纬度范围之内。对于
敏感性分析中的 k 近邻权重而言,距离在这一尺度上只受到轻微影响。
:::

### <span class="en">Townships without neighbours</span><span class="zh">没有邻居的镇区</span> {#sec-prep-islands}

::: {.en}
A contiguity-based local statistic is undefined for a polygon with no
contiguous neighbour. With queen contiguity, `r bnd$nb_report$n_no_nb`
townships have none and the neighbour graph falls into
`r bnd$nb_report$n_comp` disconnected pieces. Left alone, spdep returns an
empty neighbour set for each of them, which propagates as a missing value
through every row-standardised weight and quietly removes them from the
analysis. Each case is therefore decided on its own, by the distance to the
nearest township.
:::

::: {.zh}
对于没有任何相邻邻居的多边形,基于邻接的局部统计量没有定义。采用 queen 邻接时,有
`r bnd$nb_report$n_no_nb` 个镇区没有邻居,邻接图分裂为 `r bnd$nb_report$n_comp`
个互不连通的部分。若不处理,spdep 会为它们返回空的邻居集,这会以缺失值的形式在
每一个行标准化权重中传播,把它们悄无声息地从分析中剔除。因此本研究按每个镇区到
最近镇区的距离,逐一做出决定。
:::

```{r}
#| label: tbl-islands
#| tbl-cap: "<span class='en'>The three townships with no queen-contiguous neighbour, and what was done with each.</span><span class='zh'>三个没有 queen 邻接邻居的镇区,以及对每个镇区的处理方式。</span>"

bnd$nb_report$islands_dist |>
  mutate(Decision = ifelse(dist_km > 50,
                           "Excluded from the analytical frame",
                           paste0("Linked to ", nearest))) |>
  select(Township = TS, Pcode = TS_PCODE, `Nearest township` = nearest,
         `Edge-to-edge distance (km)` = dist_km, Decision) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(`Edge-to-edge distance (km)`, decimals = 1) |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(13))
```

```{r}
#| label: prep-islands-code
#| eval: false
ts_an <- ts_proj |>
  filter(!TS_PCODE %in% excluded) |>      # Cocokyun
  arrange(TS_PCODE)                        # see the note on sorting below

nb_an <- poly2nb(ts_an, queen = TRUE)
for (r in seq_len(nrow(linked))) {         # Munaung -> Ramree, Chaungzon -> Mudon
  i <- match(linked$TS_PCODE[r],      ts_an$TS_PCODE)
  j <- match(linked$nearest_pcode[r], ts_an$TS_PCODE)
  nb_an[[i]] <- sort(unique(c(setdiff(nb_an[[i]], 0L), j)))
  nb_an[[j]] <- sort(unique(c(setdiff(nb_an[[j]], 0L), i)))
}
stopifnot(all(card(nb_an) > 0), n.comp.nb(nb_an)$nc == 1L, is.symmetric.nb(nb_an))
```

::: {.en}
Munaung and Chaungzon lie within a few kilometres of the mainland (Chaungzon
is Bilu Island, joined to the Mawlamyine side by a bridge) and are linked to
their nearest township in both directions, which keeps the graph symmetric.
Cocokyun is more than 100 km out in the Andaman Sea. Any neighbour assigned to
it would be invented, and it carries no ACLED record of any kind in the 57
months, so it is removed from the analytical frame and kept only as a
cartographic feature. The result is `r bnd$nb_report$an_n` townships in a
single connected graph with `r sprintf("%.2f", bnd$nb_report$an_avg_links)`
neighbours on average and at most `r bnd$nb_report$an_max_links`.

The frame is sorted by `TS_PCODE` on purpose. @sec-ehsa-check shows that
sfdep's `emerging_hotspot_analysis()` labels its results correctly only when
the geometry is in that order.
:::

::: {.zh}
Munaung 与 Chaungzon 距离大陆只有几公里(Chaungzon 即 Bilu 岛,通过大桥与毛淡棉
一侧相连),因此把它们与各自最近的镇区**双向**连接,以保持邻接图的对称性。
Cocokyun 位于安达曼海中 100 多公里之外。给它分配任何邻居都是虚构的,而且它在 57 个
月中没有任何类型的 ACLED 记录,因此把它从分析框架中移除,只作为制图要素保留。
最终得到 `r bnd$nb_report$an_n` 个镇区,构成单一的连通图,平均
`r sprintf("%.2f", bnd$nb_report$an_avg_links)` 个邻居,最多
`r bnd$nb_report$an_max_links` 个。

分析框架**刻意**按 `TS_PCODE` 排序。@sec-ehsa-check 表明,只有当几何对象按这一
顺序排列时,sfdep 的 `emerging_hotspot_analysis()` 才会给结果贴上正确的标签。
:::

## <span class="en">The ACLED records</span><span class="zh">ACLED 记录</span> {#sec-prep-acled}

### <span class="en">Import, typing and basic filters</span><span class="zh">导入、类型转换与基本过滤</span>

```{r}
#| label: prep-acled-code
#| eval: false
raw <- readr::read_csv(src, show_col_types = FALSE, guess_max = 200000)
names(raw) <- tolower(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", names(raw)))

ev2 <- raw |>
  mutate(event_date = parse_event_date(event_date),
         across(c(latitude, longitude, fatalities), as.numeric)) |>
  distinct(event_id_cnty, .keep_all = TRUE) |>            # ACLED's own key
  filter(event_date >= STUDY_START, event_date <= STUDY_END,
         !is.na(latitude), !is.na(longitude)) |>
  filter(country == "Myanmar")                            # drops "Indian Ocean"
```

::: {.en}
Field names are normalised once, because ACLED has shipped the same fields
with different capitalisation across releases. Duplicates are removed on
ACLED's event identifier rather than on whole rows: two genuinely distinct
events can share a date, a place and a type. The extract turns out to be
clean on all of these counts, with `r audit$n_dup_id` duplicated identifiers,
`r audit$n_bad_date` unparseable dates, `r audit$n_out_window` dates outside
the window, `r audit$n_no_coord` missing coordinates and
`r audit$n_na_fatal` missing fatality counts. What it does contain are
`r audit$n_not_myanmar` maritime records whose `country` is "Indian Ocean";
they have no township and are dropped.
:::

::: {.zh}
字段名统一规范化一次,因为 ACLED 在不同版本中以不同的大小写发布相同字段。去重依据
ACLED 的事件标识符,而不是整行:两起真实存在的不同事件可能日期、地点与类型都相同。
这份摘录在以下各项上都是干净的:重复标识符 `r audit$n_dup_id` 个、无法解析的日期
`r audit$n_bad_date` 个、窗口之外的日期 `r audit$n_out_window` 个、缺失坐标
`r audit$n_no_coord` 个、缺失死亡人数 `r audit$n_na_fatal` 个。它确实包含
`r audit$n_not_myanmar` 条 `country` 为「Indian Ocean」的海上记录,它们没有镇区,
因此被删除。
:::

### <span class="en">Geocoding by spatial join</span><span class="zh">通过空间连接进行地理编码</span>

```{r}
#| label: prep-join-code
#| eval: false
ev_sf <- st_as_sf(ev2, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326,
                  remove = FALSE) |>
  st_transform(WORK_CRS)

idx <- st_within(ev_sf, ts, sparse = TRUE)
hit <- lengths(idx) > 0L

# Points just outside every polygon (coastal rounding) are recovered by the
# nearest township, but only within 5 km.
nn <- st_nearest_feature(ev_sf[!hit, ], ts)
dd <- as.numeric(st_distance(ev_sf[!hit, ], ts[nn, ], by_element = TRUE))
```

::: {.en}
Events are assigned to townships by point-in-polygon, not by matching ACLED's
`admin3` name to MIMU's `TS`. The two gazetteers romanise some names
differently, and a text join would silently lose every township where they
disagree. `r audit$n_outside_poly` points fall just outside every polygon, all
on the coast, and are snapped to the nearest township; the furthest is
`r round(audit$max_snap_dist_m)` m away. No event falls in the excluded
Cocokyun.

`admin3` is then used as a *check* on the join. Where ACLED gives a township
name, it agrees with the spatial join for
`r sprintf("%.2f", audit$admin3_agreement_pct)`% of events. The handful of
disagreements are a spelling variant (Pangsang against MIMU's "Pangsang
(Panghkam)") and events sitting on a township boundary.
:::

::: {.zh}
事件通过点-面包含关系分配到镇区,而不是把 ACLED 的 `admin3` 名称与 MIMU 的 `TS`
做文本匹配。两套地名录对部分名称的罗马化方式不同,文本连接会悄无声息地丢失所有
名称不一致的镇区。有 `r audit$n_outside_poly` 个点落在所有多边形之外,全部位于
海岸,被吸附到最近的镇区;最远的一个距离 `r round(audit$max_snap_dist_m)` m。没有
任何事件落在被排除的 Cocokyun。

随后用 `admin3` 作为空间连接的**检验**。在 ACLED 给出镇区名称的事件中,
`r sprintf("%.2f", audit$admin3_agreement_pct)`% 与空间连接一致。少数不一致的是
拼写变体(Pangsang 对应 MIMU 的「Pangsang (Panghkam)」)以及恰好落在镇区边界上的
事件。
:::

### <span class="en">Two land mines in the location coding</span><span class="zh">位置编码中的两颗地雷</span> {#sec-prep-landmines}

::: {.en}
The spatial join succeeds for every record, and that is exactly the danger.
Two groups of records receive a township they do not belong to.

**City-only records.** `r n_fmt(sum(audit$city_only$n))` records have no
`admin3` at all. ACLED knows these events happened in Mandalay, in Yangon or
in Nay Pyi Taw, but not in which township, and places them at a single
reference point for the city. The spatial join then assigns every one of them
to whichever township contains that point.
:::

::: {.zh}
空间连接对每一条记录都成功了,而这恰恰是危险所在。有两组记录被分配到了它们并不
属于的镇区。

**仅知城市的记录。** 有 `r n_fmt(sum(audit$city_only$n))` 条记录完全没有 `admin3`。
ACLED 知道这些事件发生在曼德勒、仰光或内比都,但不知道具体在哪个镇区,于是把它们
放在城市的单一参考点上。空间连接随后把它们全部分配给恰好包含该点的那个镇区。
:::

```{r}
#| label: tbl-cityonly
#| tbl-cap: "<span class='en'>Records with no ACLED township, and the township the spatial join would have given them. All event types are shown; the conflict column counts the three armed-conflict types.</span><span class='zh'>没有 ACLED 镇区信息的记录,以及空间连接本会把它们分配到的镇区。表中包含全部事件类型;冲突一栏只统计三类武装冲突事件。</span>"

audit$city_only |>
  group_by(`ACLED location` = location, `Township it would land in` = mimu_township) |>
  summarise(`All records` = sum(n), `Of which conflict` = sum(n[conflict]),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(`All records`)) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(13))
```

::: {.en}
Kept, they would lift Chanayethazan from outside Mandalay's top five to second
place for protests, make Bahan Yangon's most eventful township by a wide
margin (313 protests against 78 in the next township), and make Za Bu Thi Ri
the centre of almost every event in the capital. For the conflict variables
the effect is smaller, `r audit$loc_flow$city_only` events, but the mechanism
is the same.

**Region-only records.** ACLED's `geo_precision` 3 means the event is known
only to a district or a state and is coded at its capital.
`r audit$loc_flow$region_only` further conflict events are in this group.
Assigning them to the capital's township manufactures the very concentration
that a hot spot analysis looks for.

Both groups are removed from the township analysis, and the counts are kept
in the audit. Together they are
`r pct(100 * (audit$loc_flow$city_only + audit$loc_flow$region_only) / audit$loc_flow$conflict_geocoded, 2)`
of the conflict events, small enough that removing them cannot move a
regional pattern, and concentrated enough that keeping them would plant false
hot spots in a handful of city-centre townships.
:::

::: {.zh}
如果保留它们,Chanayethazan 的抗议数会从曼德勒前五名之外升到第二位;Bahan 会以
悬殊的差距成为仰光事件最多的镇区(抗议 313 起,排名其次的镇区只有 78 起);而
Za Bu Thi Ri 会成为首都几乎所有事件的中心。对冲突变量而言,影响较小,为
`r audit$loc_flow$city_only` 起事件,但机制相同。

**仅知区域的记录。** ACLED 的 `geo_precision` 3 意味着只知道事件发生在某个县或省邦,
并被编码在其首府。另有 `r audit$loc_flow$region_only` 起冲突事件属于这一组。把它们
分配给首府所在镇区,恰好会制造出热点分析所要寻找的那种集中。

两组记录都从镇区分析中移除,其计数保留在审计记录中。二者合计占冲突事件的
`r pct(100 * (audit$loc_flow$city_only + audit$loc_flow$region_only) / audit$loc_flow$conflict_geocoded, 2)`,
少到移除它们不可能改变区域格局,却又集中到保留它们就会在少数城市中心镇区埋下
虚假热点。
:::

```{r}
#| label: tbl-recordflow
#| tbl-cap: "<span class='en'>Record flow from the ACLED extract to the analysed conflict events.</span><span class='zh'>从 ACLED 摘录到最终分析的冲突事件的记录流。</span>"

n_conf <- audit$loc_flow$conflict_geocoded
tibble(
  Step = c("Records in the extract",
           "Not in Myanmar (\"Indian Ocean\")",
           "Geocoded to a MIMU township (incl. snapped)",
           "Of which armed-conflict event types",
           "City-only location (no admin3)",
           "Region-only location (geo_precision 3)",
           "Armed-conflict events analysed"),
  Records = c(audit$n_raw, -audit$n_not_myanmar, audit$n_geocoded, n_conf,
              -audit$loc_flow$city_only, -audit$loc_flow$region_only,
              audit$loc_flow$analysed),
  `Reported fatalities` = c(NA, NA, NA, audit$loc_flow$fatal_geocoded, NA, NA,
                            audit$loc_flow$fatal_analysed)
) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(c(Records, `Reported fatalities`), decimals = 0) |>
  sub_missing(missing_text = "") |>
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_body(rows = Step == "Armed-conflict events analysed")) |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(13))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-bytype
#| tbl-cap: "<span class='en'>The screening by event type, and the location precision of what remains.</span><span class='zh'>按事件类型的筛查结果,以及保留事件的位置精度。</span>"

audit$exclusion_by_type |>
  mutate(`Share at precision 2` = prec2 / analysed) |>
  select(`Event type` = event_type, Geocoded = geocoded,
         `City only` = city_only, `Region only` = region_only,
         Analysed = analysed, `Precision 1` = prec1, `Precision 2` = prec2,
         `Share at precision 2`) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(c(Geocoded:`Precision 2`), decimals = 0) |>
  fmt_percent(`Share at precision 2`, decimals = 1) |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(13))
```

::: {.en}
The precision split also justifies the choice of the township as unit
(@sec-design). Battles in particular are known only to the township for more
than half of the events, which is consistent with clashes in rural areas
reported by the township in which they occurred.
:::

::: {.zh}
精度分布也为选择镇区作为分析单元提供了依据(@sec-design)。尤其是战斗,超过一半的
事件只知道所在镇区,这与农村地区的交火按其所在镇区报道的情况相符。
:::

```{r}
#| label: fig-precision
#| fig-cap: "<span class='en'>Share of each township's analysed conflict events that ACLED could place only near the township's main town (geo_precision 2). Grey: no conflict event.</span><span class='zh'>各镇区被分析的冲突事件中,ACLED 只能放置在镇区主镇附近(geo_precision 2)的比例。灰色:没有冲突事件。</span>"
#| fig-alt: "Choropleth of the share of events with geo_precision 2 by township, generally higher in remote northern and border townships."
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 9

map_base(
  geom_sf(data = ts_map, aes(fill = share_prec2), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.05),
  title = "How precisely ACLED locates conflict events",
  subtitle = "Share of a township's events placed only 'near' its main town"
) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("#f1f5f9", "#94a3b8", "#334155"),
                       limits = c(0, 1), labels = label_percent(),
                       na.value = "#d6d3d1", name = "Precision 2")
```

::: {.interp .en}
**Location precision.** Where precision 2 dominates, ACLED knows the
township but not the village, and the township count is the most detailed
statement the data can support. Precision is highest in Yangon, where only
about one event in nine is placed this loosely, and in Mandalay and the
Ayeyarwady delta, where events are reported by ward or village. It is lowest
in Kayin, southern Shan, Kachin and Kayah, where more than half the events
are known only to the township. This is one reason the analysis stops at
township level: in those areas a point pattern would show how events were
reported, not where they happened.
:::

::: {.interp .zh}
**位置精度。** 在精度 2 占主导的地方,ACLED 知道镇区而不知道村庄,镇区计数就是数据
所能支持的最详细表述。仰光的精度最高,大约每九起事件中只有一起是这样粗略定位的;
曼德勒与伊洛瓦底三角洲次之,事件按街区或村庄报道。克伦、掸邦南部、克钦与克耶的
精度最低,超过一半的事件只知道所在镇区。这是分析停在镇区一级的原因之一:在那些
地区,点模式只能显示事件是**如何被报道**的,而不是**发生在哪里**。
:::

## <span class="en">Building the space-time panels</span><span class="zh">构建时空面板</span> {#sec-prep-panel}

```{r}
#| label: prep-panel-code
#| eval: false
make_panel <- function(d, time_col, periods) {
  d |>
    st_drop_geometry() |>
    group_by(TS_PCODE, period = .data[[time_col]]) |>
    summarise(conflict = n(),
              battles  = sum(event_type == "Battles"),
              erv      = sum(event_type == "Explosions/Remote violence"),
              vac      = sum(event_type == "Violence against civilians"),
              fatalities = sum(fatalities), .groups = "drop") |>
    complete(TS_PCODE = ts_an$TS_PCODE, period = periods,
             fill = list(conflict = 0L, battles = 0L, erv = 0L, vac = 0L,
                         fatalities = 0)) |>
    arrange(period, TS_PCODE)
}
panel_q <- make_panel(conf, "yq", quarters)
stopifnot(nrow(panel_q) == nrow(ts_an) * length(quarters),
          sum(panel_q$conflict) == nrow(conf))
```

::: {.en}
ACLED supplies rows only where something happened. A space-time cube needs
every township in every period, and the empty cells are data: a township with
no reported violence in a quarter is exactly the observation from which a
cold spot is built. `complete()` therefore fills the full
`r N_TS` × `r N_Q` grid with zeros, and two assertions check that the grid is
complete and that no event was lost or double-counted in the aggregation.
`r pct(audit$pct_zero_q)` of township-quarters are empty. The monthly panel
(`r N_TS` × `r audit$n_months`) is built the same way, and
`r audit$n_ts_zero` townships record no conflict event at all over the 57
months.
:::

::: {.zh}
ACLED 只在发生了事件的地方提供记录。时空立方体需要每个镇区在每个时期都有数据,而
空单元格本身就是数据:一个季度内没有报告暴力的镇区,恰恰是构成冷点的观测。因此用
`complete()` 以零填满完整的 `r N_TS` × `r N_Q` 网格,并用两条断言检查网格是否完整、
汇总中有没有事件丢失或被重复计算。`r pct(audit$pct_zero_q)` 的镇区-季度为空。月度
面板(`r N_TS` × `r audit$n_months`)以同样方式构建;有 `r audit$n_ts_zero` 个镇区在
57 个月中没有任何冲突事件。
:::
